summary.summary: PROVED - (a) the on-site kinetic term of weight one is unique, (1/(2 gamma c^2)) sum udot^2/w; it survives a change of parameter only with the rates referred to one clock of the system; weak field u'' = c^2 wbar^2 Lap u - gamma c^2 wbar (e - mu), Lap = sum_y (u_y - u_x) (constant 6), about any static background local speed c w_x (executed: fronts at 1.03 and 2.05 sites per ambient tick at wbar = 1, 2). (b) c is not fixed by covariance or scale covariance: a second pure number; no wake for smooth bodies needs c >= 1; on the lattice the field's phase velocity has the floor (2/pi) c and a hopping point source radiates for every c. (c) slow sources give the static law, first lattice corrections -lam/(4 pi), -lam^3 (|x|^2 - 3/4)/(24 pi); monopole and dipole silent; quadrupole power (16/15) G^4 mu^2 M^3/(c^5 d^5), G = gamma/(4 pi). (d) added: the kinetic term, c, and a reference clock.

what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 3 of 4: A rate field with its own motion: what no master clock allows, and how fast changes travel. SETTING (blocks 53, 54, 55; open PRs titled 'ail53: no master clock', 'ail54: a phase timed by the local clock', 'ail55: action and reaction'; all three rest on SUPPLIED clauses, not adopted; the axioms memo docs/MINIMAL_AXIOMS_2026-06-29.md defines no time metric, no amplitude dynamics and no conserved energy). BLOCK 53: every site of Z^3 has a positive tick rate w_x = phi_x^2 = exp(u_x), set by its six neighbours' rates through one covariant rule, and only ratios of rates mean anything; every such rule has the weak-field form u_x = average of u over the six neighbours; a record enters as a ratio kappa to its neighbours' mean (additive source log kappa). BLOCK 54: one moving record is a two-component amplitude whose phase is timed by the local clock, generator H_w = phi H phi, H the walk with the qubit as coin; in a uniform gradient force = -(energy) x grad u exactly; rays fall at -w^2 grad u + 2 (v.grad u) v at long wavelength; one walker has no rest energy. BLOCK 55 (premise: the field obeys a static law and the pair keeps a ledger <H_w> + F[u]): d<H_w>/du_x = e_x = Re chi_x^dagger (H_w chi)_x, the amplitude's energy density; the ledger is kept when the law's source is e with its mean removed (proved in that direction), and with another source s it moves at the rate sum (e - s) du/dt; pulls are matched iff sources are proportional to energies; with no master clock the field's energy has weight one, F = sum over bonds sqrt(w_x w_y) f(u_x - u_y), the unit of rate is not a variable, the coupling gamma is a pure number, and through second order the empty-space law is the averaging law for phi = sqrt(w); for the simplest bond energy F = (2/gamma) sum (phi_x - phi_y)^2 the law is (12/gamma) phi_x (phi_x - average of phi) = -(e_x - mu). NOT SETTLED there: whether an amplitude that has formed no record sources anything; how the field follows a change of its sources (the law is static). The parked statistical postulate (docs/repo/DEFERRED_DECISIONS.md, entry 1) is NOT to be assumed, adopted or re-raised; conditional statements that name their condition are fine. TASK: block 55's law is static and acts at a distance. (a) Add to the ledger a term for the field's motion that keeps weight one under w -> t w; show that the simplest is (1/(2 gamma c^2)) sum_x (du_x/dt)^2 / w_x, that the resulting equation of motion at weak field is d^2u/dt^2 = c^2 wbar^2 x (lattice Laplacian of u)/6 x const + source, so that changes travel at a speed proportional to the LOCAL rate, and find the constant. (b) Is c forced to equal the walk's limiting speed (one site per unit local time) by covariance, by scale covariance, or by the requirement that a moving body's field keeps up with it without an ever-growing wake? If not, it is a second pure number: say so. (c) Show that the static law of block 55 is the limit of slow sources, find the first correction (a retarded potential on the lattice), and compute the rate at which two bodies circling each other lose ledger to waves of u at leading order; a scalar field radiates in the monopole and dipole unless something forbids it: say what forbids the dipole here (matched pulls: the dipole moment of energy is conserved) and whether the monopole radiates. (d) State what is added to the clauses. check.py: a lattice simulation of a source switched on at t = 0, reading the front's speed at two ambient rates.  DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/a-delay-for-the-rate-field/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/a-delay-for-the-rate-field/<name>/check.py"
